body: @pasha-bolokhov I see the component as part of the module. I assume you mean that the selector is not added to any template?

That's one problem, maybe they did not want to include all components into the demo. That could be alright, as I can do it myself
However, there is some weirdness in its behaviour, please read what I described above
@pasha-bolokhov, do you mean the "Toggle Animations" button? I don't see one that's "Toggle Insert/Remove".

Yes because that component is not included into the demo. You need include it, then you will see the toggle button
And then when you click fast enough you'll see the "glitch". I'm not sure whether the cause is Stackblitz or Angular itself, I did not clone that whole demo locally
It may end up being not just a "docs" issue..
Ah, I understand now. I added it and can see what you mean. I'm fixing now and will have a PR soon. Thank you!!

Ok, so the reason it was doing that glitchy thing where multiple `div`s would show up is because toggling it on sets `isShown` to `true` (the default is `false`) but the animation time is currently set to 5 seconds. By clicking repeatedly on the button we can toggle `isShown` more rapidly than the `div` is removed from the DOM. Each click that sets `isShown` to `true` is actually inserting the `div` anew into the DOM. When we click to remove the `div` the animation takes the full five seconds to remove it and when we click to insert it it doesn't check to see if there's one already in there. It just adds a new div. Thus the cascading effect. You can see this if you watch the Elements tab in the dev tools and click repeatedly.

When I reduce the time to 100 ms it seems to clear up the problem (just because of speed). We could add styling to the host and child views, but I think that would complicate the example. As it is, the strange behavior seems to me to be a logical extension of how the element is being animated, added, and removed from the DOM.

I don't see a reason for that animation to be five seconds, but if anyone else does or knows of a better way for me to fix this please let me know.
